The MDE statement (C1) now bounds the null but is buried.

concerns.concern: The moderator is a discontinued, integrity-flagged series and the entire moderation test is identified off its cross-economy variation, yet no value in it has been cross-validated against an independent source. The manuscript engages the history and drops the two named economies, but a referee will ask: are the other 95 coverage values right? Stage 0 spot-checked 8 economies against Doing Business 2020 country profiles and Vietnam against the live World Bank API; that is not in the manuscript.
concerns.why_it_threatens_the_claim: If the coverage values are noisy in a way correlated with borrowing behaviour, the -1.975 interaction is measurement artefact. Dropping CHN/SAU does not address non-classical error in the rest of the panel.
concerns.what_would_resolve_it: Light fix: add one or two sentences reporting the Stage-0 cross-checks (8 economies vs DB2020 profiles; Vietnam vs live WB API) with the agreement tolerance, and cite audit/CODEX_S5_STAGE0_REVIEW.md. Stronger fix: pull the same 2019 bureau/registry coverage fields from the live World Bank API (source=1) for all 97 economies and report the correlation / max discrepancy against the archived snapshot.

decision_rationale: Conditional on the realistic target (development-finance / economics-of-digitalization field journal, or the UEH competition). All five prior must-fix items are substantively closed: C2 (LIT audit filed, language aligned), C5 (control x moderator check, dual-implementation), C6 (integrity history engaged, CHN/SAU sensitivity reproduced), C9 (abstract and S5.3 de-absolutised), C13 (evidence chain repaired). The remaining work is one light analytical addition (C6-R: cross-validate the moderator, largely by surfacing checks that already exist), stale framing-block cleanup (N1), citation verification (C14-R), and prose tightening (C1-R, N2-N5, C10). None requires re-estimation; none threatens the H-000500 rejection. For a general-interest Q1 outlet the recommendation stays MAJOR_REVISION / likely desk-reject on contribution (C1) - inherent to a descriptive null with no identification and not further fixable.
does_any_finding_change_the_H_000500_ver: No. H-000500 remains REJECTED under the frozen decision rule. C6-R, if the cross-validation revealed large moderator error, would weaken how affirmatively the negative interaction can be described but would not move the hypothesis into the supported branch (that needs b3 > 0, significant, robust). Every residual here bounds the strength of the reversal claim, not the rejection.
